# gsm.vizr

An htmlwidgets interface to the
[gsm.viz](https://github.com/Gilead-Public/gsm.viz) JavaScript library’s
generic `bars` and `facetBars` renderers. It provides spec construction
and validation, a stable R-to-JavaScript serialization contract, click
and selection events, Shiny bindings with proxy update verbs, and a
shared HTML dependency for other packages’ custom widgets.

One package vendors the gsm.viz bundle once. Report packages add a
single dependency instead of each carrying their own copy of the widget
JavaScript, YAML and serialization glue.

## Installation

``` r

# Latest release
pak::pak("Gilead-Public/gsm.vizr@v0.1.0")

# Development build
pak::pak("Gilead-Public/gsm.vizr@dev")
```

Always give the ref. A bare `pak::pak("Gilead-Public/gsm.vizr")`
resolves to whatever the repository’s default branch currently holds,
which is not necessarily the release.

## Usage

``` r

library(gsm.vizr)

dfSites <- data.frame(
  site = rep(c("S-001", "S-002", "S-003"), times = c(5, 3, 2)),
  flag = rep(c("2", "1", "2", "1", "0"), times = 2)
)

bars(dfSites, bars_spec(x = "site", fill = "flag"))
```

Arguments map 1:1 onto the gsm.viz spec, so gsm.viz’s documentation
remains the source of truth for what each key does.
[`bars_spec()`](https://gilead-public.github.io/gsm.vizr/dev/reference/bars_spec.md)
validates in R using the same messages as gsm.viz’s own validator, so a
malformed spec fails before it reaches a browser.

See
[`vignette("gsm-vizr")`](https://gilead-public.github.io/gsm.vizr/dev/articles/gsm-vizr.md)
for the event contract, the Shiny proxy verbs, and how to drive a chart
from a report that has no Shiny session.

## Review CSV

[`Widget_GroupOverview()`](https://gilead-public.github.io/gsm.vizr/dev/reference/Widget_GroupOverview.md)
provides **Download CSV** when comparison-risk detail is supplied. It
exports one row per review entry across all supplied sites, not just the
expanded site or currently filtered table. Dated exports use the same
inclusive 90-day flagged-or-addressed selection and ordering as the
drilldown; legacy exports include nonzero flags. Sites sort naturally by
ID, then rows sort by latest addressed date, absolute review flag, and
KRI ID. The export never recalculates scores or changes highlighting.

Schema version 2 uses these ordered column groups:

| Group | Columns |
|----|----|
| Context | `CSVSchemaVersion`, `StudyID`, `SnapshotDate`, `GroupLevel`, `GroupID`, `MetricID`, `MetricLabel` |
| Flags | `CurrentFlag`, `ReviewFlag`, `LastFlaggedDate`, `DaysSinceFlag` |
| Action | `ActionState`, `ActionedFlag`, `LastAddressed`, `DaysAgo`, `ActionedDateSource`, `ActionDateIsProxy`, `ActionWindowDays` |
| Contribution | `Weight`, `WeightMax`, `EffectiveWeight`, `Counted`, `ActionFactor` |
| Decision | `SnapshotDecisionExcluded`, `DecisionReason`, `DecisionCoversFinding` |
| Reported scores | `SiteRiskScore`, `SiteRiskNumerator`, `SiteRiskDenominator`, `ComparisonRiskScore`, `ComparisonRiskNumerator`, `ComparisonRiskDenominator`, `ComparisonRiskMetricID`, `ComparisonRiskLabel` |
| Provenance | `ActionPolicy`, `ActionAsOfDate`, `ActionExtractionDate`, `RiskSignalID`, `ActionID` |

The primary key is
`(StudyID, SnapshotDate, GroupLevel, GroupID, MetricID)` for standard
per-KRI detail. `CurrentFlag` is the matrix flag; `ReviewFlag` is the
drilldown’s historical/reviewed flag. `Counted` uses the same
Yes/No/Partly/Not weighted labels as the drilldown. Scores and their
components are copied at full precision and repeated per review row; the
exported row set is not a new denominator. Proxy dates remain
distinguishable from verified dates.

The file is UTF-8 with a BOM, a header row, CRLF records, ISO
`YYYY-MM-DD` dates, plain numeric values, and `true`/`false` booleans.
Missing values are empty. Text is quoted with embedded quotes doubled;
spreadsheet-formula-like text is prefixed with an apostrophe. Identifier
fields are strings, so import them as text to preserve leading zeros.
Filenames follow `risk-review_<StudyID>_<assessment-date>.csv` when that
context is available. Downloads are generated locally in the browser; no
data is uploaded.

## For package authors

If your package ships its own custom widget that needs `window.gsmViz`,
declare the shared dependency rather than vendoring a second copy of the
bundle:

``` r

htmltools::attachDependencies(myWidgetTags, gsm.vizr::html_dependency_gsm_viz())
```

Upgrading the bundle is then one change in one place, and every consumer
moves together.

# Package index

## Widgets

- [`bars()`](https://gilead-public.github.io/gsm.vizr/dev/reference/bars.md)
  : Render a gsm.viz bars chart
- [`facet_bars()`](https://gilead-public.github.io/gsm.vizr/dev/reference/facet_bars.md)
  : Render a faceted set of gsm.viz bars charts

## Spec construction

- [`bars_spec()`](https://gilead-public.github.io/gsm.vizr/dev/reference/bars_spec.md)
  : Build and validate a gsm.viz bars spec
- [`facet_spec()`](https://gilead-public.github.io/gsm.vizr/dev/reference/facet_spec.md)
  : Build a facetBars facet configuration
- [`js_hook()`](https://gilead-public.github.io/gsm.vizr/dev/reference/js_hook.md)
  : Mark a spec slot as literal JavaScript

## Shiny

- [`barsOutput()`](https://gilead-public.github.io/gsm.vizr/dev/reference/bars-shiny.md)
  [`renderBars()`](https://gilead-public.github.io/gsm.vizr/dev/reference/bars-shiny.md)
  : Shiny bindings for bars
- [`bars_proxy()`](https://gilead-public.github.io/gsm.vizr/dev/reference/bars_proxy.md)
  [`proxy_update_data()`](https://gilead-public.github.io/gsm.vizr/dev/reference/bars_proxy.md)
  [`proxy_update_spec()`](https://gilead-public.github.io/gsm.vizr/dev/reference/bars_proxy.md)
  [`proxy_select_category()`](https://gilead-public.github.io/gsm.vizr/dev/reference/bars_proxy.md)
  [`proxy_select_segment()`](https://gilead-public.github.io/gsm.vizr/dev/reference/bars_proxy.md)
  [`proxy_clear_selection()`](https://gilead-public.github.io/gsm.vizr/dev/reference/bars_proxy.md)
  [`proxy_export_image()`](https://gilead-public.github.io/gsm.vizr/dev/reference/bars_proxy.md)
  : Proxy for server-side updates to a rendered bars widget

## Shared runtime

- [`html_dependency_gsm_viz()`](https://gilead-public.github.io/gsm.vizr/dev/reference/html_dependency_gsm_viz.md)
  : HTML dependency for the vendored gsm.viz bundle

  **\[stable\]** : Shiny bindings for Widget_GroupOverview

  **\[stable\]** : Shiny bindings for Widget_ScatterPlot
- [`Widget_ScatterPlot()`](https://gilead-public.github.io/gsm.vizr/dev/reference/Widget_ScatterPlot.md)

- [`Widget_TimeSeriesOutput()`](https://gilead-public.github.io/gsm.vizr/dev/reference/Widget_TimeSeries-shiny.md)
